identificationModule.briefTitle: Prospective Clinical Study of ZPR Regimen in Elderly Treatment-naive Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Prospective Single-arm, Single-center Clinical Study of Zanubrutinib, Polatuzumab Vedotin and Rituximab (ZPR) Regimen in Elderly Treatment-naive Patients With Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective, single-arm, single-center clinical study. This clinical study aims to explore the efficacy and safety of the ZPR（Zanubrutinib, Polatuzumab vedotin and Rituximab）regimen in elderly patients with treatment-naive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is a prospective, single-arm, single-center clinical study. This clinical study aims to explore the efficacy and safety of the ZPR（Zanubrutinib, Polatuzumab vedotin and Rituximab）regimen in elderly patients with treatment-naive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

Primary objective: use ORR to evaluate the efficacy of ZPR in treating elderly treatment-naive DLBCL patients

Secondary objective: Evaluate the safety of ZPR treatment for elderly treatment-naive DLBCL patients

The subjects received 6 cycles of ZPR regimen, one cycle every 21 days. Then Zanubrutinib alone will continue to be used until Zanubrutinib has been used for 1 year or disease progression or intolerable adverse effects, death, withdrawal of informed consent or study termination.

Zanubrutinib（Z）160 mg bid po Day 1-21; Polatuzumab vedotin（P）1.8 mg/kg ivgtt D1; Rituximab（R）375 mg/m\^2 ivgtt D1.

primaryOutcomes.measure: ORR at the end of the 6th treatment cycle
primaryOutcomes.description: the proportion of participants who have achieved complete or partial remission determined by the researcher.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: about six months from the start of ZPR

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CRR at the end of the 6th treatment cycle
secondaryOutcomes.description: the proportion of subjects evaluated by researchers to obtain CR.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: about six months from the start of ZPR

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of patients who have achieved 2-year PFS
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the proportion of participants with a time of 2 years from the start of treatment to the first recording of disease progression or death, based on the investigator's assessment of the first occurrence
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 2-year (from the start of treatment to the first recording of disease progression or death, based on the investigator's assessment of the first occurrence)

secondaryOutcomes.description: incidence and severity of adverse events (AE) and Serious adverse event (SAE) during the study
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: between the first administration of the study drug and 30 days after discontinuation, or during the progression of the disease or the initiation of new anticancer treatment, whichever came first
